data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

My overall recommendation is **1Password if ease of use and team management matter most; Bitwarden if keeping costs down is the priority.**

A business password manager is worth having even with just 3–5 employees. The important thing is being able to share credentials securely, control who has access, and revoke access immediately when someone leaves.

## Best options for a small team

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall)

Teams Starter Pack: US\$24.95/month for up to 10 users, annually billed

- Excellent, polished user experience.
- Shared vaults for departments and projects.
- Granular access permissions.
- Security alerts for compromised and weak passwords.
- Excellent browser and mobile apps.

Best when you want something employees will actually enjoy using.

[Pricing and plans](https://1password.com/pricing/business?utm_source=chatgpt.com) · [Small business features](https://1password.com/product/teams-small-business-password-manager?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

Teams: US\$4/user/month, annually billed

- Open-source core.
- Unlimited shared collections.
- Centralized team administration.
- Activity logs and directory synchronization.
- Strong security for the price.

Best if you want excellent functionality without spending much.

[Official pricing and features](https://bitwarden.com/pricing/business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

Business Starter: approximately US\$2/user/month, annually billed

- Strong administrative controls.
- Shared team folders.
- Detailed access management.
- Good fit for security-conscious organizations.

Worth considering if you have more demanding security or compliance requirements.

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

Business pricing varies by plan

- Privacy-focused approach.
- Encrypted credential storage.
- Secure sharing.
- Good option if privacy is a major consideration.

Prices are indicative USD annual-billing rates, not necessarily Canadian-dollar checkout prices. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.northvetted.ca](https://www.northvetted.ca/reviews/best-password-manager-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[1password.com](https://1password.com/pricing/business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[bitwarden.com](https://bitwarden.com/pricing/business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd choose

| Your priority | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Best overall experience | 1Password |
| Best value | Bitwarden |
| Advanced administration | Keeper |
| Privacy-focused | Proton Pass |


For a typical small business with 5–20 employees, I'd lean toward **1Password Teams Starter Pack**\. At US\$24.95/month for up to 10 users, it's a particularly attractive starting point.

## A few questions to narrow it down

I can make a more specific recommendation if I know a little about your setup.

**1\. How many people need access?**

---

**2\. What does your team primarily use?**

---

**3\. What's most important?**

---

**4\. What will you share?**

[Get my recommendation]

One important point: whichever you choose, make sure it supports individual accounts, shared team vaults, two-factor authentication, and immediate access revocation when an employee leaves.
